import copy,json
from work import evaluate

def check(request,evidence,policy,expected):
    before=copy.deepcopy((request,evidence,policy))
    got=evaluate(request,evidence,policy)
    assert got==expected,(got,expected)
    assert (request,evidence,policy)==before
    assert set(got)=={'status','value','sources','unknowns'} and len(got)==4

r={'claim':'calibration','conditions':{'device':'A'}}
e=[
 {'source':'withdrawn','claim':'calibration','value':0,'conditions':{'device':'A'},'verified':True,'withdrawn':True},
 {'source':'unverified','claim':'calibration','value':0,'conditions':{'device':'A'},'verified':False},
 {'source':'other','claim':'other','value':0,'conditions':{'device':'A'},'verified':True}
]
check(r,e,{'required_conditions':['device'],'require_verified':True},{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
check(r,e,{'required_conditions':['device'],'require_verified':False},{'status':'supported','value':0,'sources':['unverified'],'unknowns':[]})
check({'claim':'calibration','conditions':{}},[],{'required_conditions':['device'],'require_verified':False},{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['device']})
# An eligible record may supersede an ID; an ineligible record may not. Self-supersession is not supersession by another record.
p={'required_conditions':['device'],'require_verified':True}
e2=[
 {'source':'old','claim':'calibration','value':1,'conditions':{'device':'A'},'verified':True},
 {'source':'new','claim':'calibration','value':2,'conditions':{'device':'A'},'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']},
 {'source':'bad','claim':'calibration','value':9,'conditions':{'device':'B'},'verified':True,'supersedes':['new']},
 {'source':'self','claim':'calibration','value':2,'conditions':{'device':'A'},'verified':True,'supersedes':['self']}
]
check(r,e2,p,{'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new','self'],'unknowns':[]})
# Canonical JSON ignores object member order but not false versus zero.
e3=[
 {'source':'b','claim':'calibration','value':{'x':1,'y':[2,3]},'conditions':{'device':'A'},'verified':True},
 {'source':'a','claim':'calibration','value':{'y':[2,3],'x':1},'conditions':{'device':'A'},'verified':True}
]
check(r,e3,p,{'status':'supported','value':{'x':1,'y':[2,3]},'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':[]})
e3.append({'source':'c','claim':'calibration','value':False,'conditions':{'device':'A'},'verified':True})
check(r,e3,p,{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','b','c'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); evidence=json.load(open('evidence.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json'))
assert [evaluate(x,evidence,policy) for x in requests]==json.load(open('report.json'))
print('extended checks passed')
